newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina auctions $500 mln T-bonds at 6.92 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentina auctions $500 mln T-bonds at 6.92 pct.

text.p: Argentina auctioned $500 million in two-year Bonte Treasury bonds at a cut-off yield of 6.92 percent, the Economy Ministry said Tuesday.
The sale expanded the size of the Bonte maturing on Dec 13, 1998, initially sold at a yield of 8.0 percent in December, bringing the total to $1.0 billion.
The price at the cut-off yield was 1,018. Offers ranged from a high of 8.23 percent to a low of 6.44 percent.
